payload.title: How indirect prompt injection works
payload.body_html:
How indirect prompt injection works

Indirect prompt injection happens when text that an assistant retrieves from the web carries instructions the user never wrote. The assistant may treat that text as if it came from the user.

Defences include treating retrieved text as data, scanning it before it reaches the model, and limiting what actions the assistant can take without confirmation.
